directive: 一般的html u/i (replace the mshta HTA window with a regular browser HTML UI)
architecture: Same pattern as Control Tower: launcher hosts System.Net.HttpListener on 127.0.0.1 (8766, fallback 8768/8776), serves the workbench page at /, opens the default browser, and bridges every Windows action through endpoints: POST /api/run (write worker config + spawn hidden pwsh worker), GET /api/status (worker poll), GET /api/dialog (STA WinForms file/folder picker returning real paths), GET /api/exists, POST /api/open (open file/folder via OS default, parent-folder fallback), GET /view (serve generated report HTML into iframes — replaces file:// embedding). Ctrl+C stops the server.

activex_removal_map.WScript.Shell dialog helper: GET /api/dialog (server runs the same -Sta helper, synchronous)

behavior_notes: All seven parameters, worker protocol, status schema, registries and governance gates unchanged.
Browser drag/drop cannot supply full Windows paths (unlike Explorer→HTA); UI logs guidance to use the Windows 選檔 buttons, which return real paths via the STA dialog helper.
Google Fonts now load fully (real browser engine) — the v0160B serif masthead renders as designed.
While a file dialog is open the single-threaded bridge pauses other requests (status polling resumes after choosing).
PS-side AST is formally validated by the v0103 gate on the user's machine before launch (fail-closed); JS side node --check PASS recorded here.
